introduction: Nevada WIC supports pregnancy, infant feeding and young children’s nutrition. Contact a nearby WIC clinic to arrange the assessment appointment.
description: Nevada WIC supports pregnancy, infant feeding and young children’s nutrition. Contact a nearby WIC clinic to arrange the assessment appointment.

sections.who: Applicants must live in Nevada, meet income rules and have a health or nutrition need. The program covers pregnancy, the first six postpartum months, breastfeeding an infant under one and children younger than five. Citizenship is not required.
sections.get: WIC provides nutrition support and program-approved foods. Ask the clinic about breastfeeding assistance and the benefits appropriate to each participant.
sections.docs:
• Identity records for applicants.
  • Proof of Nevada residence.
  • Household income evidence.
  • Available pregnancy or child-health information, plus anything the clinic requests.
sections.apply:
1. Find a clinic

    Use the clinic finder linked from Nevada WIC’s eligibility page.

  2. Schedule assessment

    Call the clinic and confirm who should attend and which records it accepts.

  3. Complete certification

    Discuss nutrition needs and ask staff to explain benefits, shopping and future appointments.
sections.after: Keep the clinic informed about relevant changes and follow appointment instructions. Ask staff for help using benefits or finding an approved vendor.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Nevada WIC eligibility and clinic application route. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can a father or grandparent apply for a child?
Yes. Nevada WIC welcomes caregivers and legal guardians applying for an eligible child under five.
Nevada WIC says citizenship is not required.
Does checking eligibility online enroll me?
No. Contact a clinic for assessment and certification.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
